manual_outreach_draft.comment_md:
I saw this pain point and mapped it to a small AgentPress repro/preflight so it is useful even if you ignore the project.

Run:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py mcp-config-mutation-guard --config-exists --before-sha256 <sha256-before> --existing-servers <csv> --planned-servers <csv> --json
```

What it gives you: Stops agent installers from silently breaking existing MCP/Cline/Roo config; emits backup/diff/restore evidence.

No secrets, private prompts, telemetry, or external writes required. If this misses the actual failure mode, reply with the redacted error and I’ll tighten the pack.
